fullPassage: Maya waited in line to check in for her flight. Her expectations about her European backpacking trip were really high. She had been looking forward to the trip for a year. She couldn't wait to visit museums in Madrid and see the Eiffel Tower at night in Paris. As she stood in line, she could feel those experiences were finally so close. When she approached the counter, the airline employee asked to see her passport. Maya reached into her pocket and felt nothing. She realized she had left her passport at home. Her plans were ruined. She was heartbroken, knowing she could not board the flight and had to delay her dream trip.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①기대해 왔다 ②서 있는(→stood) ③다가갔다 ④그녀의
det.analysis:
❌ ② standing → stood: As절에서 주어+동사 구조 필요. As she stood(○) / As she standing(×)
✅ ① had been looking: 과거완료진행 정상
❌ ③ approached: 과거시제 정상
❌ ④ her: 소유격 정상
det.tip: As + S + V(과거형): As she stood(○). 분사구문이면 주어 생략 필요

det.korean: ①보여달라고 ②손을 넣었다 ③두고 왔다(→had left) ④비통한
det.analysis:
❌ ③ has left → had left: realized(과거)보다 이전 시점이므로 대과거(had left) 필요
✅ ① to see: ask + to부정사 정상
❌ ② reached: 과거시제 정상
❌ ④ heartbroken: 감정 형용사 정상
det.tip: 대과거: 과거 시점(realized)보다 더 이전 → had p.p.

det.korean: ①그녀의 ②느끼다 ③알면서(→knowing) ④미루다
det.analysis:
❌ ③ known → knowing: 분사구문으로 이유/동시상황을 나타내므로 현재분사 knowing이 필요. known은 과거분사
✅ ① her: 소유격 정상
❌ ② feel: 조동사 could 뒤 동사원형 정상
❌ ④ delay: had to + 동사원형 정상
det.tip: 분사구문(이유): , knowing ~(~라는 것을 알기에). known(과거분사)은 수동적 의미

questions.stem:
주어진 단어를 올바른 순서로 배열하시오. (대소문자 구분 없음, 마침표 생략 가능)
[ she / realized / she / her passport / had left / at home ]

det.korean: 그녀는 여권을 집에 두고 왔다는 것을 깨달았다.
det.analysis: ✅ She realized she had left her passport at home: 주절(realized) + 종속절(had left=대과거)
det.tip: realize + that절. 대과거: had left(깨달은 시점보다 이전 행위)

questions.wa: She realized she had left her passport at home
accept: She realized she had left her passport at home
she realized she had left her passport at home
She realized she had left her passport at home.

questions.stem:
위 글의 내용을 바탕으로 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 **영어** 표현을 쓰시오.
"Maya was __________ when she realized her passport was missing."
(heartbreak을 알맞은 형태로 쓸 것)

det.korean: Maya는 여권이 없다는 것을 알았을 때 __________했다.
det.analysis: ✅ heartbroken: 감정형용사. was heartbroken(비통했다)
det.tip: heartbreak(명사) → heartbroken(형용사). be heartbroken = 비통하다

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 **영어** 표현을 쓰시오.
"Maya는 여권을 가져오지 않아서 비행기에 탑승할 수 없었다."
→ Maya could not __________ the flight because she forgot her passport.
(적절한 영어 단어를 쓸 것)

det.korean: Maya는 여권을 잊어버려서 비행기에 __________할 수 없었다.
det.analysis: ✅ board: could not board the flight = 비행기에 탑승할 수 없었다
det.tip: board = 탑승하다. board a flight/plane/train
